paragraphs: The M2 CS is the top-tier F87-generation M2, produced from 2018 to 2021 as the successor to the M2 Competition. Under the bonnet, it uses the S55 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six petrol engine derived from the F80 M3/F82 M4's power unit, retuned for the M2 CS with 444 bhp. The S55 is a different engine from the earlier F87 base M2's N55 — it's more powerful, uses a more sophisticated closed-deck block design, and carries its own well-documented crank hub characteristic. The M2 CS was a limited-run model and is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
